title: Gross Salary
description: Your total earnings before tax and deductions, for the pay period selected.

title: Pay Period
description: Choose the period your salary figure covers, such as a month or a year.

title: Tax Year
description: Choose the year you want to calculate. A UK tax year runs from 6 April to 5 April the following year.

title: Tax Code
description: Use the code on your payslip, P45 or HMRC account, such as 1257L.
note: You can leave this blank to estimate using the allowances for your income, region and selected tax year.

title: Tax Region
description: Choose where you live for tax purposes. Scotland has different Income Tax bands.

title: Hours Worked
description: Your usual weekly working hours, used to work out hourly pay.

title: Pension
description: Enter your own contribution as % of gross salary or £ for the selected pay period. Changing between % and £ resets it to 0.
note: We use salary sacrifice to estimate pension deductions.

title: Contribution Type
description: Choose % of your gross salary or a £ amount for the selected pay period. Changing between them resets your contribution to 0.

title: Student Loan Plan
description: Choose the plan shown in your student loan account. If you also repay a postgraduate loan, add it using the checkbox.

title: National Insurance Category
description: Use the National Insurance category letter on your payslip. A is the standard category for most employees.

title: Marriage Allowance
description: Select if you are married or in a civil partnership. Enter your partner's annual pay so we can check whether a Marriage Allowance transfer could apply.

title: Partner's Gross Wage
description: Your partner's yearly pay before tax, used to check Marriage Allowance eligibility.

title: Blind Person's Allowance
description: Select if you qualify for Blind Person's Allowance, which increases the income you can receive before paying Income Tax.

title: Age
description: Choose whether you have reached your State Pension age. This affects employee National Insurance.

title: No National Insurance
description: Select if you are exempt from employee National Insurance, for example because you have reached State Pension age.

title: Non-taxable Allowance(s)
description: Extra pay your employer marks as non-taxable, for the selected pay period.
note: For example, reimbursed expenses. This is added to take-home pay; it does not reduce your taxable salary.

title: Annual Revenue
description: Your company's total sales for the year, before business expenses. Enter revenue, not profit.

title: Revenue Includes VAT
description: Select if your revenue figure includes VAT.
note: This changes VAT warnings. VAT is not subtracted from your revenue.

title: Business Expenses
description: Your yearly business costs, such as rent, software and contractors.
note: Leave out your own salary and the employer National Insurance on it: we calculate these separately.

title: Monthly Contract Income
description: What you expect to invoice each month, before business expenses.
note: We assume this stays the same from your selected start month through March.

title: Monthly Business Expenses
description: Your usual monthly business costs, such as rent, software and contractors.
note: Leave out your own salary and the employer National Insurance on it: we calculate these separately.

title: Contract Start Month
description: Choose the month your current level of income started. We assume the same monthly income from then through March.

title: Cash In Bank
description: The money currently in your company's bank account, available for bills and paying yourself. Use the bank balance rather than profit shown in your accounts.

title: Minimum Monthly Draw
description: The minimum amount you need to take from the company each month for your personal spending. This helps set your cash reserve target.

title: Runway Target
description: How many months of business costs and minimum personal withdrawals you want to keep in reserve.
note: The target reserve is this number multiplied by your monthly expenses plus your minimum monthly draw.

title: Company Year-End
description: The date your company's accounting year ends. Check Companies House or ask your accountant if you are unsure.

title: Custom Year-End Date
description: Enter the month and day as MM-DD. For example, 06-30 means 30 June.

title: Salary Already Taken
description: Your gross salary paid through PAYE since 6 April. This is included when we work out how much you have already taken from the company.

title: Dividends Already Taken
description: Dividends declared since 6 April. These are included when we work out how much you have already taken from the company.

title: Other Drawings
description: Money you have taken from the company since 6 April that was not salary or dividends, such as withdrawals through your director's loan account.

title: Other Personal Income
description: Your yearly personal income from outside this company, such as another job or rental income. This can affect the tax on your dividends.

title: Other PAYE Employment
description: Select if you also have a PAYE job elsewhere.

title: Employment Allowance
description: Select only if your company qualifies for this reduction in employer National Insurance. A company with just one director and no other employees usually cannot claim.

title: Student Loans
description: Select the repayment plans shown in your student loan account. We include an estimate of repayments through Self Assessment.
note: Plan 5 is not supported in Director Intelligence.

title: Employer Pension
description: The yearly amount your company pays directly into your pension. We use this to reduce company profit before Corporation Tax.

title: Pension Included in Business Expenses
description: Select if the company pension contribution is already in the business expenses you entered. This stops us deducting it twice.

title: Company Car BIK
description: The yearly taxable benefit for your company car, shown on your P11D or provided by your employer. Enter the benefit value, not the car's price.

title: Associated Companies
description: The total number of associated companies, including this one. These are generally companies under common control.
note: This number affects the profit thresholds used for Corporation Tax. Ask your accountant if you are unsure.

title: Losses Brought Forward
description: Trading losses from earlier years that can be used against this year's taxable company profit.

title: Minimum Salary
description: The lowest yearly salary you want to consider, even if a lower salary would save tax.

title: Your Current Salary
description: Your yearly gross salary from the company. Enter it here, then choose Apply to compare your setup with the suggested options.

title: Your Current Dividends
description: Your yearly dividends from the company. Enter them here, then choose Apply to compare your setup with the suggested options.
